scenario: Browser persistence handles persist=false, insufficient quota, a second tab, and explicit writer takeover.
input: StorageManager.persist returns false, quota drops below the reservation, or a second tab opens the same project while another writer lease is active.
visibleError: The storage-capacity and read-only states are surfaced as actionable browser alerts instead of silently saving.
recovery: A write retries only after capacity is available; the second tab becomes writable only after explicit takeover revokes the old writer.
sideEffects: Rejected writes do not create assets or stale snapshots, and the displaced writer cannot save after takeover.
